facts.text: The hotel sits in Downtown Vancouver's Stadium District, steps from BC Place Stadium and Rogers Arena.
facts.excerpt: places guests at the heart of Downtown Vancouver’s Stadium District—steps from BC Place Stadium and Rogers Arena

facts.text: The hotel sits along False Creek, with Yaletown and Granville Island close by.
facts.excerpt: From our elevated setting along False Creek, guests can move effortlessly into Yaletown’s chic dining and boutique culture or travel across the water to the artisan energy of Granville Island

facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city, ocean and mountain views.
facts.excerpt: retreat to waterfront luxury accommodations with floor-to-ceiling windows and scenic city, ocean and mountain views

facts.text: The two-bedroom Sky Suites are wrapped in floor-to-ceiling windows and bathed in light on three sides.
facts.excerpt: Wrapped in floor to ceiling windows, our two bedroom luxury suites are bathed in light on three sides

facts.text: Each Sky Suite has a personal media room at the heart of the suite.
facts.excerpt: Your personal media room occupies the heart of the suite, inviting you to screen a film or conduct business.

facts.text: The two-level Parq Villa has white oak floors and a 600-square-foot terrace with views of the False Creek waterfront.
facts.excerpt: features white oak wooden floors throughout and a sliding wall of glass that grants access to a 600-square-foot terrace with views of False Creek waterfront

facts.text: Spa by JW sits on the 17th-floor wellness level and overlooks BC Place and False Creek.
facts.excerpt: Spa by JW Vancouver offers a luxury day spa experience on the 17th-floor wellness level of JW Marriott Parq Vancouver. Overlooking BC Place and False Creek

facts.text: The rooftop Aqua Lounge is an outdoor pavilion with a hydrotherapy tub overlooking BC Place and False Creek.
facts.excerpt: Perched on the rooftop of the 17th floor, the Aqua Lounge is an outdoor pavilion overlooking BC Place and False Creek.

facts.text: The Aqua Lounge is not a standard swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Please note that this is not a standard swimming pool.

facts.text: The spa offers the Mind-Sync Harmonic Sleep Lounger, a zero-gravity chair using vibro-acoustic sound wave therapy.
facts.excerpt: The Mind-Sync Harmonic Sleep Lounger is a zero-gravity chair that uses Vibro-Acoustic sound wave therapy to guide you into deep restorative states

facts.text: The Organic Honey Detox wellness journey uses raw honey from the hotel's resident JW Garden honeybees.
facts.excerpt: From the Organic Honey Detox — featuring raw honey from our resident JW Garden honeybees

facts.text: The wellness floor includes a 4,240-square-foot fitness studio, steam rooms and a manicure and pedicure bar.
facts.excerpt: the space includes a 4,240-square-foot fitness studio, an Aqua Lounge terrace with a whirlpool, a manicure and pedicure bar, and steam rooms

facts.text: The Victor is a sixth-floor rooftop restaurant featuring Pacific Northwest seafood and specialty steaks.
facts.excerpt: The Victor, Parq Vancouver's sixth-floor rooftop restaurant in downtown Vancouver features a seasonally inspired menu highlighting Pacific Northwest seafood and specialty steaks.

facts.text: D/6 Lounge is an indoor/outdoor rooftop bar with views of the city skyline.
facts.excerpt: our hotel's hip, vibrant and exclusive indoor/outdoor rooftop bar in Vancouver, BC. Enjoy views of the city skyline alongside specialty cocktails and light bites.

facts.text: Restaurants and lounges at Parq Vancouver are led by Elizabeth Blau and chef Kim Canteenwalla.
facts.excerpt: led by James Beard Award– nominated masterminds Elizabeth Blau and her husband, chef Kim Canteenwalla

facts.text: Guests have access to Parq Vancouver's 72,000-square-foot gaming facility, including private salons.
facts.excerpt: Access to Parq Vancouver’s 72,000 square-foot world class gaming facility features the latest advancements in gaming in a contemporary and natural light-infused environment, as well as private salons

facts.text: The hotel's accommodations are crafted to LEED Gold certification.
facts.excerpt: crafted to LEED Gold certification

facts.text: Guests are greeted with a scent and sound from the JW Marriott x Flamingo Estate collaboration.
facts.excerpt: The moment a guest arrives at our hotel, they are met with an herbaceous and uplifting scent and a unique sound

facts.text: Pet-friendly rooms welcome one dog per room, up to 15 kg.
facts.excerpt: pet-friendly rooms welcome one dog per room (up to 15 kg)

facts.text: Platinum, Titanium and Ambassador Elite members get complimentary Executive Lounge access.
facts.excerpt: Platinum, Titanium, and Ambassador Elite Members enjoy complimentary access to the JW Marriott Executive Lounge

facts.text: The hotel is attached to a casino and right next to BC Place.
facts.excerpt: it is attached to a casino after all, and right next to BC Place, the city’s sports stadium

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says it is not a place for travelers seeking a quiet or low-key experience.
facts.excerpt: This isn’t a place for a traveler looking for a more quiet or low key experience.

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours.
facts.excerpt: enjoy 24-hour in-room dining in your room or suite
